mapper.select: SELECT g.code_grp_id, g.code_grp_nm, g.sys_code_yn, g.val_code_yn, g.sort_ord, (SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.code_grp_id=g.code_grp_id AND c.del_yn='N') AS code_count FROM TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ORDER BY g.sort_ord, g.code_grp_id
mapper.sql: code_grp_id, code, code_nm, sort_ord, use_yn, del_yn, code_val, unit_nm, add_val1, add_val2, add_val3, COALESCE(mod_dttm, reg_dttm) AS changed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND del_yn='N' ORDER BY sort_ord, code
SELECT FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND code=#{code}
SELECT COALESCE(max(sort_ord),0)+1 FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_CODE SET code_nm=#{codeName},sort_ord=#{sortOrd},use_yn=#{useYn}, code_val=#{codeVal,jdbcType=NUMERIC},unit_nm=#{unitNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, add_val1=#{addVal1,jdbcType=VARCHAR},add_val2=#{addVal2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, add_val3=#{addVal3,jdbcType=VARCHAR},mod_user_id='admin', mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), COALESCE(mod_dttm, reg_dttm) + INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND code=#{code} AND del_yn='N'
UPDATE TB_SY_CODE SET del_yn='Y',mod_user_id='admin',mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND code=#{code} AND del_yn='N'
LOCK TABLE ${table} IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.sql: #{row.code}, #{row.codeName}, (SELECT h.bfr_val FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_CODE' AND h.trgt_key=#{row.groupId} || ':' || #{row.code} AND h.chg_item_nm='CODE_NM' ORDER BY h.hist_id LIMIT 1)
mapper.select:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${ref.table} r WHERE
r.asgn_chg_type_cd = 'KIND''EXTP' AND (r.bfr_val=#{row.code} OR r.aft_val=#{row.code})
r.${ref.column} IN (#{row.code},#{row.codeName}) OR r.${ref.column} IN ( SELECT h.bfr_val FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_CODE' AND h.trgt_key=#{row.groupId} || ':' || #{row.code} AND h.chg_item_nm='CODE_NM' UNION SELECT h.aft_val FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_CODE' AND h.trgt_key=#{row.groupId} || ':' || #{row.code} AND h.chg_item_nm='CODE_NM')
r.${ref.column}=#{row.code} )
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CODE_MAP WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND code=#{code})

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE NOT (c.code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND c.code=#{code}) AND (
(c.code_grp_id IN ('JOB','SKILL','RSM_JOB_KW') AND #{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(c.add_val1,'\s*,\s*')))
(c.code_grp_id='PROJ_STEP' AND #{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(c.add_val2,'\s*,\s*')))
FALSE )) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm NOT IN ('TB_SY_CODE','TB_SY_CODE_GRP') AND h.chg_item_nm=#{groupId} AND (h.bfr_val=#{code} OR h.aft_val=#{code})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_CODE' AND h.trgt_key != #{groupId} || ':' || #{code} AND (
(h.trgt_key ~ '^(JOB|SKILL|RSM_JOB_KW):' AND h.chg_item_nm='ADD_VAL1' AND (#{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(h.bfr_val,'\s*,\s*')) OR #{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(h.aft_val,'\s*,\s*'))))
(h.trgt_key LIKE 'PROJ_STEP:%' AND h.chg_item_nm='ADD_VAL2' AND (#{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(h.bfr_val,'\s*,\s*')) OR #{code}=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(h.aft_val,'\s*,\s*'))))
FALSE ))
